Name: PPJA - Legacy Sprites
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DwFK8Ni.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/asuQXFm.png[/img]

- A collection of all of the legacy PPJA sprites for items that have been added to the vanilla game
- Each object is toggleable. Default is false.

Includes:
[list]
[*]Banana
[*]Banana Pudding
[*]Dragon Tooth
[*]Ginger (Object)
[*]Ginger Ale
[*]Green Tea
[*]Mango
[*]Pina Colada
[*]Pineapple
[*]Rice (Crop)
[*]Taro
[*]Tea Leaf
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Eqdpuvd.png[/img]

- Latest version of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]
- Latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional, allows you to edit config's on the title screen)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]﻿

Step 1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There is 1 file included in the download:

[CP] PPJA Legacy Sprites

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]

- Remove the [CP] PPJA Legacy Sprites folder

Downloads.Description:
If you're using the old Fruits and Veggies legacy sprites, remove that mod before installing this as it includes them.
Everything defaults to false.

Drag + Drop into `Mods`
